rounding_model.FP32_pair_envelope: Sparse rounding term + dense rounding term + |F^T-A^T|*|v| + 2*U64.
rounding_model.FP64_algebra_gate: Frozen-coefficient sparse action and autograd VJP must agree coordinatewise with F*x and F^T*x within gamma_53(m_s)*S(x) + gamma_53(m_r)*(|F_or_F^T|*|x|)/(1-gamma_53(m_r))^2.
rounding_model.S: Absolute expanded sparse DAG mass for x, including the self terms that cancel; correct its FP64 positive summation by 1/(1-gamma_53(m_s)). Both branches, permutation, aggregation lengths, final addition/division and adjoint traversal are charged.
rounding_model.coefficient_gates: Exact public direct support/unit weights/degrees and star incidences/counts; reciprocal error <=(gamma_24(1)+gamma_53(2))*ideal weight. Every |F-R| coordinate <=gamma_24(m_cs)*|R| plus FP64 construction uncertainty, and every |A-R| coordinate <=gamma_24(m_cd)*|R| plus that uncertainty. Thus coefficient error cannot be absorbed without its own formation gate.
rounding_model.gamma: gamma_b(m)=m*2^-b/(1-m*2^-b), b=24 for FP32 and 53 for FP64. Every budget is determined from graph sizes/reduction lengths before observing an output discrepancy.
rounding_model.normal_rounding_domain: Explicit gates require finite fixed probes with magnitudes 0 or [2^-32,1], full degrees/star counts <2^15, frozen reciprocals in [2^-16,1], and normalization in (0,2^16). With integer/unit factors this bounds nonzero primitive dyadic intermediates below overflow and above FP32 underflow (>=2^-110). The standard round-to-nearest gamma model is conditional on this domain; failure stops qualification.
rounding_model.symbols: n=terminal count; U=public interior count; d=max raw direct degree; t=max terminal star incidences; k=max terminals per interior. R=independent FP64 approximation of the rational public-graph operator; F=independent public-clique matrix with the frozen FP32 reciprocal weights/normalization; A=unchanged original FP32 dense matrix promoted to FP64.
